observations.body: The travelers return to the gathered group and hear a concise report that the risen Lord has appeared to Simon.
observations.label: The Lord has appeared to Simon

observations.body: The passage presents Announcement and road report as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Announcement and road report

observations.body: The passage places The Lord has appeared to Simon beside Announcement and road report.
observations.label: The Lord has appeared to Simon

payload.posture: Read Luke 24:33–35 as one movement in Peter's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the travelers return to the gathered group and hear a concise report that the risen Lord has appeared to Simon. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Peter's story.
payload.title: The Lord has appeared to Simon
